name: weird
quote: What was that crazy loud sound?
description: Something perceived as out of the ordinary, neither harmful nor disgusting, but you're not sure it's something you want to experience often.
perceptions: There's an aspect of that person, group, or thing that's unusual.
The aspect is neither admirable nor disgusting.

guidance.description: That's Weird! Being Curious Instead of Critical

variations.name: attention-seeking weird
variations.description: A person or group you perceive as trying to be unusual in order to get attention for some reason.
perceptions: There's an aspect of that person, group, or thing that's unusual.
The aspect is neither admirable nor disgusting.
They're doing it just to stand out.

variations.name: silly weird
variations.description: A person or group you perceive as trying to be funny, but instead seem more immature than appropriate.
perceptions: There's an aspect of that person, group, or thing that's unusual.
The aspect is childlike or less serious than the situation calls for.
They're doing it to be funny.

variations.name: good weird
variations.description: Perception of something or someone unusual in a way you admire, but don't necessarily want to copy.
perceptions: There's an aspect of that person, group, or thing that's unusual.
Not sure I want to copy them, but I'm glad they're that way.
examples: An unusual outfit on a movie star that you appreciate.
A visit to the modern art museum.

guidance.description: Too often we hide or suppress our weirdness because people don’t understand it. Don’t do this! To be more creative, to do brilliant work, you need to be prepared to be odd.

variations.name: bad weird
variations.description: Perception of something unusual that you would prefer to avoid experiencing again if possible
perceptions: There's an aspect of that person, group, or thing that's unusual.
It would be nice if they were just normal.
examples: an unusual outfit on a movie star that you dislike

commentaries.quote: People who have a taste for novelty probably like 'weird' more than those that have more constrained preferences.
Whether you try too hard to fit in or you try too hard to stand out, it is of equal consequence: you exhaust your significance.
There many inspiring quotes praising 'good weird'. Being a little unusual is pretty normal, but it's hard to tell how various social groups will judge your particular idiosyncrasy over time.
We all want to be extraordinary and we all just want to fit in.
